turns.teacher: Good morning children. Settle down, settle down. Today we will do fifty two minus twenty seven. Everybody write 52 - 27 in your copy.
turns.label: other

turns.teacher: Rabi, you got 35. Tell me beta, how did you get 35? What did you do in the ones place?
turns.label: ask_to_explain

turns.teacher: Ravi, look at the ones column. Top is 2, bottom is 7. Can we take 7 sticks away from only 2 sticks? Or did you take 2 from 7?
turns.label: targeted_question

turns.teacher: Come here Ravi. Here are 5 bundles and 2 loose sticks, that is fifty two. You need to remove 7 loose sticks. You have only 2. So open one bundle. Now count the loose sticks. How many?
turns.label: concrete_materials

turns.teacher: Very good Ravi, you opened the bundle and saw 12 loose sticks, and 4 bundles are left. That is exactly right. Now 12 take away 7, and 4 bundles take away 2 bundles.
turns.label: specific_praise

turns.teacher: Sana, you are sitting so nicely. Can you tell us softly, what answer did you get for fifty two minus twenty seven?
turns.label: invite_quiet_child
